DiscountedOrderItemId.description: Unique identifier of [Order item](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/orderitems/#order-item) which has been discounted by current item.

AllowanceProductOrderItemId.description: Unique identifier of the allowance product [Order item](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/orderitems/#order-item) which credit has been consumed by current item.
